paragraphs.source_en: If you take just one concept away from part II, it should be that space is different from Earth. Space is different, and attempts to compare spacefaring to earthly exploration tend to make it sound easier than it will be. Sailing a galleon around the world is damned impressive, but it’s still an extension of swimming or sitting on a floating log—stuff humans and other animals do naturally.
